summary.zh: 客户端在 API 请求里用来指定这个模型的名字。
summary.en: The name clients use to pick this model in API requests.

what.zh: OpenAI 兼容接口 /v1/models 返回的模型名。留空时按模型目录或仓库名自动生成。
what.en: The model name listed by the OpenAI-compatible /v1/models endpoint. Empty means it is derived from the model folder or repository.

whenToChange.zh: 客户端配置里写死了某个模型名，或想给同一模型的不同启动方案起不同名字时。
whenToChange.en: When a client is configured with a fixed model name, or to tell launch variants of one model apart.

tradeoffs.zh: 改名后，仍按旧名字调用的客户端需要同步修改。
tradeoffs.en: Clients that still call the old name must be updated.

summary.zh: 这个模型是对话模型还是向量（embedding）模型。
summary.en: Whether this model is a chat model or an embedding model.

what.zh: chat 不加任何参数；embedding 对应 --is-embedding。
what.en: chat adds nothing; embedding maps to --is-embedding.

whenToChange.zh: 启动向量模型时。对话模型保持默认。
whenToChange.en: When you start an embedding model. Leave chat models at the default.

tradeoffs.zh: embedding 实例不提供对话接口。
tradeoffs.en: Embedding instances do not serve the chat API.

summary.zh: 权重与激活使用的浮点精度；auto 按模型配置选择。
summary.en: The floating-point type for weights and activations; auto follows the model config.

what.zh: 模型计算使用的数据类型。auto 读取模型 config.json 中的 torch_dtype。
what.en: The data type used for model computation. auto reads torch_dtype from the model's config.json.

whenToChange.zh: 较老的显卡不支持 BF16 时改为 float16；排查数值问题时可以试 float32。
whenToChange.en: Use float16 on older GPUs without BF16 support; try float32 when chasing numerical problems.

tradeoffs.zh: float32 精度最高，但显存和速度代价都很大；float16 在部分模型上可能溢出。
tradeoffs.en: float32 is the most precise but costs a lot of memory and speed; float16 can overflow on some models.

summary.zh: 权重使用的量化格式；留空时从模型配置自动识别。
summary.en: The quantization format of the weights; empty detects it from the model config.

what.zh: 量化权重的解码方式，例如 AWQ、GPTQ、FP8 或 NVFP4。模型 config.json 声明了 quant_method 时以模型为准。
what.en: How quantized weights are decoded, for example AWQ, GPTQ, FP8 or NVFP4. When the model's config.json declares quant_method, the model wins.

whenToChange.zh: 模型没有声明量化方式，或要把未量化的权重在线量化成 FP8 时。
whenToChange.en: When the model does not declare its quantization, or to quantize unquantized weights to FP8 while loading.

tradeoffs.zh: 格式选错会加载失败；在线量化省显存，但可能略微降低质量。
tradeoffs.en: A wrong format fails to load; quantizing while loading saves memory but can cost a little quality.

summary.zh: 单独指定分词器所在的目录或 Hugging Face 仓库。
summary.en: A separate folder or Hugging Face repository for the tokenizer.

what.zh: 默认使用模型目录里的分词器。GGUF 模型常常需要指向对应的原始仓库。
what.en: By default the tokenizer inside the model folder is used. GGUF models often need the original repository here.

whenToChange.zh: 模型目录缺少分词器文件，或 GGUF 转换出的分词器不准确时。
whenToChange.en: When the model folder has no tokenizer files, or the tokenizer converted from GGUF is inaccurate.

tradeoffs.zh: 分词器与模型不匹配会导致输出乱码。
tradeoffs.en: A tokenizer that does not match the model produces garbled output.

summary.zh: 允许加载模型仓库自带的 Python 代码。
summary.en: Allows the Python code shipped with the model repository to run.

what.zh: 新架构或自定义架构的模型需要执行仓库里的建模代码才能加载。
what.en: New or custom architectures need the repository's modeling code to load.

whenToChange.zh: 模型说明要求 trust_remote_code，或加载时报告未知架构时。
whenToChange.en: When the model card asks for trust_remote_code, or loading reports an unknown architecture.

tradeoffs.zh: 会在容器里执行第三方代码，只对来源可信的模型开启。
tradeoffs.en: Third-party code runs inside the container; turn it on only for models from sources you trust.

what.zh: auto 在目录里只有 GGUF 文件时按 GGUF 加载，否则按 Hugging Face 格式加载。
what.en: auto loads GGUF when the folder only holds GGUF files, and the Hugging Face format otherwise.

whenToChange.zh: 目录里同时有多种格式、自动判断不对时。
whenToChange.en: When a folder holds several formats and auto picks the wrong one.

tradeoffs.zh: vLLM 对 GGUF 的支持仍是实验性的。
tradeoffs.en: vLLM's GGUF support is still experimental.

summary.en: Overrides fields of the model's config.json with a JSON object.

what.zh: 对应 --json-model-override-args。最长 8 KiB。扩展上下文时可填 {"rope_scaling":{"rope_type":"yarn","factor":4,"original_max_position_embeddings":32768}}，辅助界面会帮你生成。
what.en: Maps to --json-model-override-args. At most 8 KiB. To extend the context use {"rope_scaling":{"rope_type":"yarn","factor":4,"original_max_position_embeddings":32768}}; a helper in the console builds it for you.

whenToChange.zh: 需要改模型配置而不想复制整个模型目录，例如用 YaRN 扩展上下文，或修正错误的架构名。
whenToChange.en: When you need to change the model config without copying the model folder, for example to extend the context with YaRN or fix a wrong architecture name.

tradeoffs.zh: 字段写错或和权重不匹配会让加载失败或输出异常；它会改变模型行为，请对照模型卡。
tradeoffs.en: A wrong field or one that does not match the weights fails to load or garbles output; it changes model behaviour, so check it against the model card.

summary.zh: 单个请求最多可用的 token 数，包括提示词和生成内容。
summary.en: The most tokens one request may use, prompt and output together.

what.zh: 模型在一次请求里能看到的最大 token 数。更长的请求会被拒绝。
what.en: The largest number of tokens the model sees in one request. Longer requests are rejected.

whenToChange.zh: 处理长文档、长对话或整个代码库时调大；只做短问答时调小以节省显存。
whenToChange.en: Raise it for long documents, long chats or whole code bases; lower it for short questions to save memory.

tradeoffs.zh: 越大越占 KV 缓存显存，同样的显存能同时服务的长请求越少。
tradeoffs.en: Larger values need more KV-cache memory, so fewer long requests fit at the same time.

summary.zh: 引擎同时处理的请求数上限，多出来的请求排队等待。
summary.en: How many requests the engine serves at the same time; the rest wait in a queue.

what.zh: 同时运行的请求（序列）数量上限。
what.en: The cap on requests (sequences) running at once.

whenToChange.zh: 多人或多个客户端同时使用时调大；单人使用长上下文时调小。
whenToChange.en: Raise it when several people or clients share the model; lower it for one user with long context.

tradeoffs.zh: 并发越高总吞吐越大，但每个请求分到的 KV 缓存越少，长请求更容易排队。
tradeoffs.en: More concurrency raises total throughput, but each request gets less KV cache and long requests queue sooner.

what.zh: 对应 --chunked-prefill-size，平台默认 8192。
what.en: Maps to --chunked-prefill-size; the platform default is 8192.

whenToChange.zh: 预填充长提示词时显存峰值过高就调小。
whenToChange.en: Lower it when prefilling long prompts peaks too high in memory.

tradeoffs.zh: 越小越省激活显存，但长提示词开始回答得更慢。
tradeoffs.en: Smaller chunks save activation memory but make long prompts slower to start answering.

summary.zh: 一批预填充最多处理多少个 token。
summary.en: The most tokens one prefill batch may process.

what.zh: 对应 --max-prefill-tokens。它和“分块预填充大小”一起决定预填充的显存峰值。
what.en: Maps to --max-prefill-tokens. Together with “Chunked prefill size” it sets the prefill memory peak.

whenToChange.zh: 长提示词预填充时显存紧张就调小；显存宽裕且想加快预填充就调大。
whenToChange.en: Lower it when long-prompt prefill runs short of memory; raise it to prefill faster when memory is plentiful.

tradeoffs.zh: 越大预填充越快，但激活值占用的显存越多，也可能挤占解码。
tradeoffs.en: Larger values prefill faster but use more activation memory and can crowd out decoding.

summary.en: Sets SGLang's running-request cap directly and wins over Max concurrent requests; validated recipes usually derive it from cache capacity.

what.zh: 设置后用它代替最大并发请求作为 --max-running-requests。
what.en: When set, it replaces Max concurrent requests as --max-running-requests.

whenToChange.zh: 混合架构的状态缓存只够少数请求同时运行时。

label.zh: 静态显存比例（启动时空闲显存）
label.en: Static memory fraction (of free VRAM at start)

summary.zh: SGLang 按启动时空闲显存的这个比例分配权重和 KV 池。
summary.en: SGLang sizes the weights plus the KV pool as this fraction of the memory free when it starts.

what.zh: 对应 --mem-fraction-static。它是空闲显存的比例，不是整卡比例：桌面或其它模型已经占用的显存不算在内。
what.en: Maps to --mem-fraction-static. It is a fraction of free memory, not of the whole GPU: memory the desktop or other models already use is not counted.

whenToChange.zh: 启动时报显存不足就调小；需要更大的 KV 池时调大。
whenToChange.en: Lower it when the start runs out of memory; raise it for a bigger KV pool.

tradeoffs.zh: 过高会让 CUDA Graph 和激活没有余量而崩溃；配合 KV 池容量上限可以让显存准入的预算可预测。
tradeoffs.en: Too high leaves no room for CUDA graphs and activations and can crash; pairing it with a KV pool size limit keeps the admission budget predictable.

what.zh: 保存注意力键值（KV）使用的精度。auto 与模型计算精度相同。
what.en: The precision used to store attention keys and values. auto matches the model's compute dtype.

whenToChange.zh: 需要更长上下文或更多并发、而显存不够时选 FP8。
whenToChange.en: Choose FP8 when you need longer context or more concurrency than memory allows.

tradeoffs.zh: FP8 KV 可能轻微影响长上下文质量，部分模型路径不支持。
tradeoffs.en: FP8 KV can slightly reduce long-context quality, and some model paths do not support it.

summary.en: Reuses work for prompts that start the same way, which speeds up multi-turn chats and repeated system prompts.

what.zh: SGLang 默认开启 RadixAttention 前缀缓存；选择关会传 --disable-radix-cache。
what.en: SGLang keeps its RadixAttention prefix cache on by default; Off passes --disable-radix-cache.

whenToChange.zh: 排查与缓存相关的输出异常，或模型路径不支持前缀缓存时关闭。
whenToChange.en: Turn it off to rule out cache-related output problems, or when the model path does not support it.

tradeoffs.zh: 开启几乎总是更快，会用一部分 KV 缓存保存可复用的前缀。
tradeoffs.en: On is almost always faster; it keeps part of the KV cache for reusable prefixes.

what.zh: 对应 --max-total-tokens。不设置时，SGLang 用静态显存比例在权重之外剩下的全部空间。
what.en: Maps to --max-total-tokens. Unset, SGLang fills whatever the static memory fraction leaves after the weights.

whenToChange.zh: 需要限制显存占用，或让显存准入的预算可预测时。

tradeoffs.zh: 页越大，前缀复用的粒度越粗，未填满的页浪费越多。
tradeoffs.en: Bigger pages reuse prefixes more coarsely and waste more on partly filled pages.

whenToChange.zh: 带 PLE 的模型显存紧张、又需要长上下文时。

tradeoffs.en: Uses system RAM, and embedding lookups get slightly slower.

label.zh: 分层 KV 缓存（内存）

summary.zh: 把放不下显存的 KV 缓存换到系统内存里，需要时再读回。
summary.en: Moves KV cache that does not fit in VRAM to system memory and reads it back when needed.

what.zh: 对应 --enable-hierarchical-cache。内存池大小由“内存与显存缓存比例”决定。
what.en: Maps to --enable-hierarchical-cache. The memory pool size follows “RAM-to-VRAM cache ratio”.

whenToChange.zh: 多轮长对话或共享长前缀很多，显存里的前缀缓存放不下、命中率低时。
whenToChange.en: For many multi-turn long conversations or shared long prefixes that do not fit in the VRAM prefix cache and give a low hit rate.

tradeoffs.zh: 换入换出要经过 PCIe 和内存，命中缓存时也比显存慢；需要足够的系统内存。
tradeoffs.en: Swapping crosses PCIe and system memory and is slower than a VRAM hit; it needs enough system RAM.

what.en: Maps to --hicache-ratio. It is only used with the hierarchical KV cache on; unset, SGLang uses 2.

whenToChange.en: Raise it when system RAM is plentiful and you want to cache more prefixes; lower it when RAM is tight.

tradeoffs.zh: 比例越大占用的系统内存越多，可能挤占其他程序。
tradeoffs.en: A larger ratio uses more system RAM and can crowd out other programs.

what.en: Tensor parallelism splits the weights inside each layer and needs fast links between the GPUs.

tradeoffs.en: Single requests are usually slower than with tensor parallelism; it needs concurrency to keep every stage busy.

summary.zh: 在多张 GPU 上各放一份完整模型，分摊请求。

what.zh: 每个副本独立处理请求，总吞吐随副本数增加。
what.en: Each replica serves requests on its own, so total throughput grows with the replica count.

whenToChange.en: When one GPU holds the model and you need more total throughput.

whenToChange.zh: 并发较高、超过默认捕获范围时调大；启动时显存紧张或捕获太慢时调小。
whenToChange.en: Raise it for high concurrency above the default capture range; lower it when startup memory is tight or capture takes too long.

tradeoffs.zh: 越大覆盖的批越多、解码越快，但捕获更久、占用更多显存。
tradeoffs.en: Larger values cover more batches and decode faster, but capture takes longer and uses more memory.
